data.one_liner: View and filter your drift database directly inside your Flutter application.
data.what_it_does: A debugging tool that displays your drift database contents inside a dedicated screen in your app. It provides filtering at the database level without requiring you to export the database file.
use_when: You are using drift for local storage in your Flutter app and need to inspect data during development
You want to filter and view database contents quickly without exporting files
avoid_when: You are running a production build and want to exclude developer inspection tools
You are using a storage solution other than drift
strengths: Allows viewing and filtering the database directly inside the app
Eliminates the need to export database files for inspection
weaknesses: Requires special handling (@JsonKey) when using named columns
data.setup_notes: Simply push the DriftDbViewer widget onto your navigator passing your database instance.
